### Agents and sessions

- Run multiple coding agents in parallel, each in its own isolated git worktree.
- Supports Claude, Cursor, opencode, Codex and Antigravity through one adapter interface.
- Rich Chat shows each agent as a structured conversation, with a raw terminal tab alongside.
- Spawn subagents from a running session and watch them from the parent.

### Workspace and code navigation

- Per-agent file tree, file search and a built-in code viewer with go to definition and find references.
- Symbol outline and references panel backed by language servers, with a text-search fallback.
- Git status and PR state shown per branch, with a live dashboard of which agents are working, idle or waiting on you.
- Drafts let you queue a task and start it later in a new or existing worktree.

### Interfaces

- Web UI, desktop app (Linux AppImage and deb, macOS dmg) and a `vst` CLI all drive the same local daemon.
- The web UI works on mobile and installs as a PWA, reachable over Tailscale.
- Token login by default, with origin checks on every write.

### Install

- One-line installer: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fastestdevalive/vibe-station/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`
- CLI builds for Linux x86_64 and aarch64 and macOS Apple Silicon; the daemon is a single static binary.
- The Linux desktop app needs glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04+); the CLI runs on any Linux.
